attribute_scores.rationale: While the validation rules are generally clear, combining numerous constraints into a dense block causes readability issues.
Omits explicit details on the error messages or UI notification mechanisms triggered when validations fail.
Uses terminology consistent with the Guru99 Banking project domain.
Fails to follow proper syntactic structure (e.g., lacking 'The Guru99 Banking system shall...' and using imperative/descriptive fragments instead of normative modal verbs).
Validation rules for customer profile editing are standard, technically realistic, and accurate for web banking forms.
Massively violates singularity by packing dozens of independent validation rules for multiple distinct form fields into a single requirement statement.
Each validation rule can be tested, but the compound nature of the requirement makes test case traceability difficult.

The text relies on informal bullet-like fragments mixed with test case IDs instead of proper requirements syntax.
